result.summary: Found 2 issues: a content issue with untranslated placeholder text and a potential layout issue with the bottom navigation bar.

issues.description: The section header displays 'home_feed.popular_title' which appears to be an untranslated or unrendered placeholder string instead of a proper section title.
issues.suggestion: Replace 'home_feed.popular_title' with the appropriate localized section title text.

issues.description: The bottom navigation bar appears to overlap with the bottom edge of the screen, which may cause usability issues on certain devices or screen sizes.
issues.suggestion: Adjust the layout to ensure the bottom navigation bar has proper spacing from the screen edge.
